headline: GOLD FALLS TO $4,564 as Iran Strikes Hormuz Vessels — "Project Freedom" Fails to Lift Metals
snippet: Spot gold slipped to $4,564/oz and silver fell to $73.71 on May 4 as Trump's Strait of Hormuz escort operation launched and Iran immediately struck vessels and set a UAE oil port on fire. Safe-haven metals dipped as investors had largely priced in the geopolitical risk before the operation began.

headline: PINCH-YOURSELF GRADES: Power Metallic Intercepts 9.47% CuEq Over 17.45m at Nisk Quebec
snippet: Power Metallic Mines (TSX-V: PNPN) released winter 2026 drill results from Nisk's Lion Zone in Quebec, including 17.45m at 9.47% CuEqRec and 39m at 5.66% CuEqRec — the strongest near-surface copper intersections at the project to date. Infill drilling is progressing toward a 2026 mineral resource estimate on what the company calls a potential multi-mine scale copper-gold system.

headline: PM SECTOR MAJOR ALERT: Strong Evidence the Precious Metals Bottom Is Now In
snippet: A GoldSeek technical analysis published May 4 argues the evidence for a precious metals sector low is "compelling," with downside risk now minimal and the next major upleg in gold, silver, and mining equities appearing to have started. The piece points to multiple technical indicators converging in the PM sector after weeks of corrective action.

headline: HERAEUS: Divided Fed Won't Cut Rates — But Europe's EV Boom Is Quietly Backing Silver
snippet: In its weekly precious metals report, Heraeus argues that a fractured Federal Reserve won't deliver the rate cuts gold needs to sustain its bull run, even as macro uncertainty persists. On silver, the refiner highlights that surging EU electric vehicle sales are creating a structural floor under industrial demand even while gold ETF flows remain subdued.

headline: CLIVE MAUND: "Charts Line Up for a Major Precious Metals Rally" — Here's What to Watch
snippet: Technical analyst Clive Maund, featured on Money Metals Exchange on May 4, argues the technical setups for gold, silver, copper, and mining equities are aligning for a significant upside move. He identifies chart patterns in the PM sector signaling a breakout could be imminent and outlines specific levels to watch for confirmation.

headline: USA RARE EARTH Rocketed 72% in April — The $2.8B Serra Verde Deal That Changed the Chart
snippet: USA Rare Earth (USAR) surged 72% in April after announcing a definitive agreement to acquire Brazil's Serra Verde Group for approximately $2.8 billion — creating the only non-Asian supplier capable of delivering all four magnetic rare earth elements at scale. The deal includes a 15-year U.S. government offtake agreement and is expected to generate ~$1.8B in annualized EBITDA by 2030.

headline: P2 GOLD Drills 74.68m at 0.69 g/t Au at Lucky Strike Zone — Walker Lane Trend, Nevada
snippet: P2 Gold released infill and expansion drill results from the Lucky Strike Zone at its Gabbs Project on Nevada's Walker Lane Trend on May 4, highlighted by 74.68m at 0.69 g/t Au and 0.25% Cu, including a higher-grade interval of 30.48m at 1.32 g/t Au and 0.38% Cu. A mid-2026 resource update remains on track as the company continues to expand the zone's footprint.

headline: CASCADIA Launches Yukon's Biggest Copper-Gold Drill Program Since 2007 — 15,000m Underway at Carmacks
snippet: Cascadia Minerals (TSX-V: CAM) has mobilized crews to its fully permitted Carmacks copper-gold project in central Yukon, kicking off its largest diamond drill program since 2007 at 15,000m. Approximately 10,000m targets resource expansion at the main Carmacks Deposit, with the balance focused on near-deposit zones and regional exploration targets across the road-accessible property.

headline: Who's WINNING the Junior Mining Exploration Race in 2026? The Field Is Thinning Fast
snippet: African Mining Online surveys the 2026 junior exploration landscape, with high-grade copper-gold results from Power Metallic, NGEx Minerals, and Kalahari Copper Belt players pulling ahead of the pack. The piece argues the gap between well-funded explorers with drill-ready targets and the rest of the market is now wider than any time in the past decade.

headline: Gold Closes at $4,629 Comex: Analyst Sees INTERIM LOW — Eyes $4,300 Mid-Year Correction Before Next Leg
snippet: Gold Eagle's May 2 technical update places Comex gold in a corrective pattern after pulling back from all-time highs near $5,600, with the near-term sector cycle still trending down. The analyst identifies $4,300 as the key mid-year support zone, describes the current bull market as "at halftime," and maintains a long-term target range of $10,000–$15,000 by 2030.
